About.heading: About
About.description: Back-end-focused Full-Stack Developer in Yogyakarta building hospital and clinic information systems with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, and Oracle.
About.paragraph: Full-Stack Developer with a stronger focus on the back end and under 2 years of experience building and maintaining hospital and clinic information systems using PHP, Laravel, MySQL, and Oracle. Experienced with Docker, CI/CD, Redis caching, and production incident handling. Familiar with Golang and Flutter. Available on-site from early January 2027, and open to relocation and remote roles.

bullets: Develop and maintain comprehensive Hospital Information Systems for multiple healthcare institutions using PHP, CSS, JavaScript, and Oracle Database.
Build clinic web applications with Laravel and MySQL, focused on usability and maintainability.
Built a web interface based on the framework of the Analyzer System.
Optimize complex database schemas and queries to ensure accurate, real-time data usage.
Use Docker and GitLab CI/CD pipelines to keep environments consistent and simplify deployment.
Monitor application health with New Relic, diagnose issues through logs, and handle production incidents.
Implemented data caching strategies using Redis to store frequently accessed database queries, successfully reducing API response latency.
Use Claude Code to speed up boilerplate and feature development.
Continued development and maintained web and mobile applications for clients using Laravel, React, Tailwind CSS, and Flutter.
Developed features and maintained a Laravel-based microservice architecture.
Worked on an employee attendance application with a Flutter frontend and a Golang backend.
Built a responsive admin dashboard with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring charts and tables.
Used Laravel packages such as Spatie, Breeze, and Inertia to speed up development.
Implemented Figma designs with Tailwind CSS and used AWS S3 for file storage.
Worked in a 2–3 person team using Git/GitHub and Kanban.
Contributed to SWAKARTA, a Waqf-based CMS platform with 20 customizable templates built on Laravel MVC, letting non-technical users launch websites in under 30 minutes.
Built a modular template system using Laravel MVC to support dynamic content management.
Worked in a 4–6 member team using Git/GitHub and Kanban (Trello).
